origin.usage: na.spline.default(object, x = index(object), xout, ..., na.rm = TRUE, maxgap = Inf, along)

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Series or vector in which missing values are replaced.

arguments.name: x, xout
arguments.text: Abscissae used for interpolation, as in approx. x defaults to the index, and xout defaults to x.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, leading and trailing NAs that remain are removed with na.trim.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: Maximum run of consecutive NAs to fill. Longer gaps are left unchanged.

arguments.name: along
arguments.text: Deprecated. Used as x when x is missing.
Further arguments passed to approx or splinefun. The n argument of approx is not used.

origin.details: The default method splines each column and returns the numeric result. With one observed point the value is copied onto a matching xout and every other query stays missing.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.spline.default(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
